purpose: Independently challenge original answers and newly identified 2026 regulation changes without falsely claiming scored key or accredited QA.

cases.original_stem: Pe un circuit care alimentează mai multe receptoare electrice de putere de aceeaşi natură şi destinaţie

original_options.A: nu se prevede protecție comună la scurtcircuit
original_options.B: nu se prevede protecție comună la suprasarcină
original_options.C: se prevede protecție la suprasarcină dacă puterea totală instalată depăşeşte 16 kW

findings.A: Not universally correct: §5.3.1.1 specifically permits common short-circuit protection for alike loads up to 15 kW.
findings.B: NOT independently positively demonstrated as a categorical prohibition of shared overload protection. Per-motor protection requirements and allowed methods are not equivalent to a universal device-location ban.
findings.C: 16 kW threshold is not supported by source's 15 kW common short-circuit allowance and does not establish when overload protection begins.

cases.next_gate: Look for exact rule specifically forbidding common overload protection or document exam-language ambiguity, then qualified technical/language reviewer.

source_scope_correction.initial_inference_to_reject: ANRE Ord15/2026 adds Art8(4) participation guarantee to Ord59/2013 and therefore changes the Art8 choice-of-network-operator rule.
source_scope_correction.verified_exact_instrument: Article IV of Order ANRE 15/2026 amends the CAPACITY ALLOCATION METHODOLOGY approved by Order 53/2024, adding its Article 8(4) guarantee. Article I of Order15/2026 separately amends the Ord59/2013 CONNECTION REGULATION, including Articles 2,31 and other entries, not the original Art8(2) choice text. Do not transpose Article IV 'Article 8' to the Regulation under Ord59.
source_scope_correction.original_stem_object: Connection applications for production/consumption up to 50 MW, routed to distribution concessionaire or another distribution operator with nearby network.
source_scope_correction.exact_original_source_unchanged_in_ident: Ord59/2013 Regulation Art8(1) >50MW to transmission-system operator; Art8(2) <=50MW routes to a local concessionaire or other nearby-network distribution operator, depending on siting. The verified 15/2026 amendment to the Methodology does not itself erase these options.
source_scope_correction.caveat: This is regulation-object and amendment attribution review, not 2026 scored ANRE key authentication or full exhaustive corpus check.

cases.further_gate: Independent legally qualified reader to confirm applicable grade bibliography and official scored key, check later changes as-of exam date.

cases.source_scope_note: 959/2023 item8 changes I7 §3.0.3.4: fully dielectric optical communications cables are a narrowly defined exception to avoidance of risky shared route; do not confuse optical-only with hybrid cables.
959/2023 item52 rewrites §7.22.1. One supply may be used under P118/2 conditions when no reserve fire pump is required, other fire-safety loads may need two independent sources.
Revised 7.22.1 still treats any number of feeds from the national transmission/distribution network as ONE SEN supply source for a customer, separate backup sources must be truly independent.
